title: Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty
summary: The United States, Soviet Union and United Kingdom signed this treaty in Moscow, banning nuclear weapons tests in the atmosphere, outer space and underwater while permitting underground tests. Prompted by public concern over fallout, it was soon signed by more than 100 other governments, though France and China did not sign.

as_recorded.value: treaty signed in Moscow on August 5, 1963

where.modern_name: Moscow (proxy pin: Moscow, the location Wikidata lists)

importance.justification: Landmark Cold War arms-control agreement that ended atmospheric nuclear testing by the three original parties and drew broad international adherence.
